paragraphs.en: Official, AWS-supported MCP servers, skills, and plugins to help AI agents build on AWS
paragraphs.zh: 官方的、AWS 支持的 MCP 服务器、技能和插件，帮助 AI 智能体在 AWS 上进行构建

paragraphs.en: Help AI coding agents build, deploy, and manage applications on AWS.
paragraphs.zh: 帮助 AI 编程智能体在 AWS 上构建、部署和管理应用程序。

paragraphs.en: The Agent Toolkit for AWS gives AI coding agents the tools, knowledge, and guardrails they need to work with AWS services. It works with the coding agents developers already use — including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kiro, and fx.
paragraphs.zh: 适用于 AWS 的智能体工具包为 AI 编码智能体提供了使用 AWS 服务所需的工具、知识和防护机制。 它可以与开发者已经在使用的编码智能体协同工作——包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin、Kiro 和 fx。

sents.en: The Agent Toolkit for AWS gives AI coding agents the tools, knowledge, and guardrails they need to work with AWS services.
sents.zh: 适用于 AWS 的智能体工具包为 AI 编码智能体提供了使用 AWS 服务所需的工具、知识和防护机制。

sents.en: It works with the coding agents developers already use — including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Kiro, and fx.
sents.zh: 它可以与开发者已经在使用的编码智能体协同工作——包括 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin、Kiro 和 fx。

paragraphs.en: Use the Agent Toolkit directly from your terminal with the AWS CLI:
paragraphs.zh: 直接在终端中使用 AWS CLI 运行智能体工具包（Agent Toolkit）：

paragraphs.en: aws configure agent-toolkit See the AWS CLI integration guide for setup, configuration, and usage instructions.
paragraphs.zh:
aws configure agent-toolkit
请参阅 AWS CLI 集成指南以了解设置、配置和使用说明。

paragraphs.en: The plugins are available on the official Anthropic marketplace ( claude-plugins-official ) which is added to your Claude Code installation by default. Use the following commands to install supported plugins from the toolkit:
paragraphs.zh: 这些插件可在 Anthropic 官方市场（claude-plugins-official）上获取，该市场默认已添加到你的 Claude Code 安装中。 使用以下命令从该工具包安装受支持的插件：

sents.en: The plugins are available on the official Anthropic marketplace ( claude-plugins-official ) which is added to your Claude Code installation by default.
sents.zh: 这些插件可在 Anthropic 官方市场（claude-plugins-official）上获取，该市场默认已添加到你的 Claude Code 安装中。

sents.en: Use the following commands to install supported plugins from the toolkit:
sents.zh: 使用以下命令从该工具包安装受支持的插件：

paragraphs.en: For aws-core that covers service selection, CDK/CloudFormation, serverless, containers, storage, observability, billing, SDK usage, and deployment:
paragraphs.zh: 对于覆盖服务选择、CDK/CloudFormation、无服务器、容器、存储、可观测性、计费、SDK 使用和部署的 aws-core：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install aws-core@claude-plugins-official Tip: If you get Plugin not found , update your local marketplace index first:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install aws-core@claude-plugins-official 提示：如果出现 Plugin not found，请先更新你的本地市场索引：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official For aws-agents that covers building AI agents on AWS with Amazon Bedrock and AgentCore:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace update claude-plugins-official 适用于 aws-agents 的插件，内容涵盖使用 Amazon Bedrock 和 AgentCore 在 AWS 上构建 AI 智能体：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install aws-agents@claude-plugins-official For aws-data-analytics that covers data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install aws-agents@claude-plugins-official 适用于覆盖数据湖、分析和 ETL 工作流（使用 S3 Tables、AWS Glue 和 Athena）的 aws-data-analytics 智能体：

paragraphs.en: /plugin install aws-data-analytics@claude-plugins-official For aws-agents-for-devsecops used to investigate incidents, review code and execute UAT for release readiness, scan code for vulnerabilities, and run penetration tests with AWS DevOps Agent and AWS Security Agent.
paragraphs.zh: /plugin install aws-data-analytics@claude-plugins-official 用于事件调查、代码审查、执行 UAT 以评估发布就绪度、扫描代码漏洞，以及配合 AWS DevOps Agent 和 AWS Security Agent 运行渗透测试的 aws-agents-for-devsecops 智能体。

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws /plugin install aws-agents-for-devsecops /reload-plugins # Or from Claude's official marketplace: /plugin install aws-agents-for-devsecops@claude-plugins-official /reload-plugins # Setup: /aws-agents-for-devsecops:setup For aws-startup-advisor that covers startup-focused architecture, cost, security, and AWS Activate guidance, plus migrations to AWS from Azure, GCP, Heroku, and AI stacks such as OpenAI and Gemini, install from this repository's marketplace:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws /plugin install aws-agents-for-devsecops /reload-plugins # 或者从 Claude 官方市场安装： /plugin install aws-agents-for-devsecops@claude-plugins-official /reload-plugins # 设置： /aws-agents-for-devsecops:setup 对于 aws-startup-advisor，它涵盖面向初创企业的架构、成本、安全以及 AWS Activate 指导，还包括从 Azure、GCP、Heroku 以及 OpenAI 和 Gemini 等 AI 技术栈迁移到 AWS 的指导，请从本仓库的市场安装：

paragraphs.en: /plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws /plugin install aws-startup-advisor@agent-toolkit-for-aws /reload-plugins Codex In your terminal:
paragraphs.zh: /plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws /plugin install aws-startup-advisor@agent-toolkit-for-aws /reload-plugins Codex 在你的终端中：

paragraphs.en: codex plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws Then launch Codex and run /plugins to browse and install the aws-core plugin.
paragraphs.zh: codex plugin marketplace add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws 然后启动 Codex 并运行 /plugins，浏览并安装 aws-core 插件。

paragraphs.en: Add this repository as a team marketplace from Settings → Plugins → Team Marketplaces → Add Marketplace → Import from Repo , pointing it at aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws . Cursor indexes the plugins listed in .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json on import.
paragraphs.zh: 在「设置 → 插件 → 团队市场 → 添加市场 → 从仓库导入」中，将此仓库添加为团队市场，指向 aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws。 导入时，Cursor 会索引 .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json 中列出的插件。

sents.en: Add this repository as a team marketplace from Settings → Plugins → Team Marketplaces → Add Marketplace → Import from Repo , pointing it at aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws .
sents.zh: 在「设置 → 插件 → 团队市场 → 添加市场 → 从仓库导入」中，将此仓库添加为团队市场，指向 aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws。

paragraphs.en: Then open the Plugins panel and install the aws-core plugin (start here), or aws-agents and aws-data-analytics as needed. Each plugin bundles the AWS MCP Server configuration and agent skills.
paragraphs.zh: 然后打开插件面板，安装 aws-core 插件（从这里开始），或根据需要安装 aws-agents 和 aws-data-analytics。 每个插件都打包了 AWS MCP 服务器配置和智能体技能。

sents.en: Then open the Plugins panel and install the aws-core plugin (start here), or aws-agents and aws-data-analytics as needed.
sents.zh: 然后打开插件面板，安装 aws-core 插件（从这里开始），或根据需要安装 aws-agents 和 aws-data-analytics。

paragraphs.en: devin plugins install aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws#plugins/aws-core This requires devin auth login and adds the plugin to your personal plugins, so it also loads in Devin cloud sessions and Devin Desktop. Add --local to install on this machine only. To install a different plugin, replace aws-core with its name from Plugins , such as aws-agents or aws-data-analytics .
paragraphs.zh: devin plugins install aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws#plugins/aws-core 这需要先执行 devin auth login，并将该插件添加到你的个人插件中，因此它在 Devin 云端会话和 Devin Desktop 中也会加载。 添加 --local 可仅在这台机器上安装。 要安装其他插件，请将 aws-core 替换为「插件」页面中的名称，例如 aws-agents 或 aws-data-analytics。

sents.en: devin plugins install aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws#plugins/aws-core This requires devin auth login and adds the plugin to your personal plugins, so it also loads in Devin cloud sessions and Devin Desktop.

paragraphs.en: In the Devin web app, choose Customize → Plugins → Add plugin → From repository , enter aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws , and set the subdirectory to plugins/aws-core (or another plugin's directory). Personal plugins added there are also available in the Devin CLI and Devin Desktop.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Devin 网页应用中，选择 Customize → Plugins → Add plugin → From repository，输入 aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws，并将子目录设置为 plugins/aws-core（或其他插件所在目录）。 在那里添加的个人插件也可在 Devin CLI 和 Devin Desktop 中使用。

sents.en: In the Devin web app, choose Customize → Plugins → Add plugin → From repository , enter aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws , and set the subdirectory to plugins/aws-core (or another plugin's directory).
sents.zh: 在 Devin 网页应用中，选择 Customize → Plugins → Add plugin → From repository，输入 aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws，并将子目录设置为 plugins/aws-core（或其他插件所在目录）。

sents.en: Personal plugins added there are also available in the Devin CLI and Devin Desktop.

paragraphs.en: Kiro setup has two independent parts: the AWS MCP Server (for runtime AWS API access and documentation search) and local skills (for task-specific agent guidance). They complement each other but work independently — skills don't require the MCP server, and the MCP server doesn't serve locally-installed skills.
paragraphs.zh: Kiro 的设置包含两个独立的部分：AWS MCP 服务器（用于运行时 AWS API 访问和文档搜索）以及本地技能（用于特定任务的智能体指导）。 两者互为补充但彼此独立工作——技能不需要 MCP 服务器，而 MCP 服务器也不提供本地安装的技能。

sents.en: Kiro setup has two independent parts: the AWS MCP Server (for runtime AWS API access and documentation search) and local skills (for task-specific agent guidance).
sents.zh: Kiro 的设置包含两个独立的部分：AWS MCP 服务器（用于运行时 AWS API 访问和文档搜索）以及本地技能（用于特定任务的智能体指导）。

sents.en: They complement each other but work independently — skills don't require the MCP server, and the MCP server doesn't serve locally-installed skills.
sents.zh: 两者互为补充但彼此独立工作——技能不需要 MCP 服务器，而 MCP 服务器也不提供本地安装的技能。

paragraphs.en: 1. Add the AWS MCP Server to your Kiro MCP configuration ( .kiro/settings/mcp.json ):
paragraphs.zh: 1. 将 AWS MCP Server 添加到你的 Kiro MCP 配置（.kiro/settings/mcp.json）中：

sents.en: Add the AWS MCP Server to your Kiro MCP configuration ( .kiro/settings/mcp.json ):
sents.zh: 将 AWS MCP Server 添加到你的 Kiro MCP 配置（.kiro/settings/mcp.json）中：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "aws" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } The MCP server gives your agent access to AWS APIs, sandboxed script execution, and real-time documentation search.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "aws" : { "command" : " uvx " , "args" : [ " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } 该 MCP 服务器为你的智能体提供对 AWS API 的访问、沙箱化脚本执行以及实时文档搜索功能。

paragraphs.en: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills This installs skill files to ~/.kiro/skills/ (global) or .kiro/skills/ (project-level). Each skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file and optionally a references/ subdirectory with additional context the agent reads from the local filesystem when needed. Kiro discovers installed skills automatically and activates them on demand when a task matches.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills 该命令会将技能文件安装到 ~/.kiro/skills/（全局）或 .kiro/skills/（项目级）。 每个技能都是一个目录，其中包含一个 SKILL.md 文件，还可以选择包含一个 references/ 子目录，智能体在需要时会从本地文件系统读取其中的附加上下文。 Kiro 会自动发现已安装的技能，并在任务匹配时按需激活它们。

sents.en: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills This installs skill files to ~/.kiro/skills/ (global) or .kiro/skills/ (project-level).
sents.zh: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills 该命令会将技能文件安装到 ~/.kiro/skills/（全局）或 .kiro/skills/（项目级）。

paragraphs.en: Prerequisites: You need uv installed. An AWS account with credentials configured locally is required for API calls and script execution, but not for documentation search or skill discovery. See the user guide for detailed setup instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 前提条件：需要安装 uv。 调用 API 和执行脚本需要本地已配置凭证的 AWS 账户，但查阅文档或发现技能则不需要。 详细的设置说明请参阅用户指南。

paragraphs.en: 1. Add the AWS MCP Server from your terminal. fx stores MCP servers in ~/.fx/mcp.json , so the server is available in every project:
paragraphs.zh: 1. 在终端中添加 AWS MCP Server。fx 将 MCP 服务器存储在 ~/.fx/mcp.json 中，因此该服务器在每个项目中都可用：

sents.en: Add the AWS MCP Server from your terminal. fx stores MCP servers in ~/.fx/mcp.json , so the server is available in every project:
sents.zh: 在终端中添加 AWS MCP Server。fx 将 MCP 服务器存储在 ~/.fx/mcp.json 中，因此该服务器在每个项目中都可用：

paragraphs.en: fx mcp add aws uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp --metadata AWS_REGION=us-west-2 Or add it to ~/.fx/mcp.json by hand. fx uses the mcp key rather than mcpServers , type to select the transport, and a single command array holding the executable and its arguments:
paragraphs.zh: fx mcp add aws uvx mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp --metadata AWS_REGION=us-west-2 或者手动将其添加到 ~/.fx/mcp.json 中。fx 使用 mcp 键而非 mcpServers，用 type 来选择传输方式，并使用一个单独的 command 数组来存放可执行文件及其参数：

paragraphs.en: { "mcp" : { "aws" : { "type" : " local " , "command" : [ " uvx " , " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } If a session is already open when you edit the file, run /mcp reload to pick up the change. The MCP server gives your agent access to AWS APIs, sandboxed script execution, and real-time documentation search.
paragraphs.zh: { "mcp" : { "aws" : { "type" : " local " , "command" : [ " uvx " , " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } 如果编辑文件时已有会话处于打开状态，请运行 /mcp reload 以使更改生效。 该 MCP 服务器为你的智能体提供对 AWS API、沙箱脚本执行以及实时文档搜索的访问能力。

sents.en: { "mcp" : { "aws" : { "type" : " local " , "command" : [ " uvx " , " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } If a session is already open when you edit the file, run /mcp reload to pick up the change.
sents.zh: { "mcp" : { "aws" : { "type" : " local " , "command" : [ " uvx " , " mcp-proxy-for-aws-cli@latest " , " https://aws-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp " , " --metadata " , " AWS_REGION=us-west-2 " ] } } } 如果编辑文件时已有会话处于打开状态，请运行 /mcp reload 以使更改生效。

sents.en: The MCP server gives your agent access to AWS APIs, sandboxed script execution, and real-time documentation search.
sents.zh: 该 MCP 服务器为你的智能体提供对 AWS API、沙箱脚本执行以及实时文档搜索的访问能力。

paragraphs.en: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills -a fx This installs skill files to .fx/skills/ (project-level); add -g to install to ~/.fx/skills/ (global). fx also discovers skills already installed for other agents in .agents/skills/ , .claude/skills/ , and .codex/skills/ , so a project set up for Codex or Claude Code needs no second copy. Each skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file and optionally a references/ subdirectory with additional context the agent reads from the local filesystem when needed. fx reads skill metadata at startup and loads a skill's instructions when you or the agent invokes it; type $ in the composer or run /skills to browse what's installed.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add aws/agent-toolkit-for-aws/skills -a fx 会将技能文件安装到 .fx/skills/（项目级）；加上 -g 则安装到 ~/.fx/skills/（全局）。fx 还能发现已为其他智能体安装在 .agents/skills/、.claude/skills/ 和 .codex/skills/ 中的技能，因此为 Codex 或 Claude Code 配置好的项目无需再复制一份。 每个技能都是一个包含 SKILL.md 文件的目录，并可选地包含一个 references/ 子目录，其中存放智能体在需要时从本地文件系统读取的额外上下文。fx 在启动时读取技能元数据，并在你或智能体调用某个技能时加载其指令；在输入框中键入 $ 或运行 /skills 即可浏览已安装的技能。

paragraphs.en: Plugins bundle the AWS MCP Server configuration and agent skills into a single install for your coding agent.
paragraphs.zh: 插件将 AWS MCP Server 配置和智能体技能打包为单一安装，供你的编码智能体使用。

paragraphs.en: Plugins are currently available for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin. For other agents, configure the AWS MCP Server directly and install skills from this repository.

paragraphs.en: Agent skills are curated packages of instructions and reference materials that help agents complete specific AWS tasks. Skills are loaded on demand — agents discover and retrieve only what's relevant to the current task.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体技能是经过精心整理的指令和参考资料包，帮助智能体完成特定的 AWS 任务。 技能按需加载——智能体只发现和检索与当前任务相关的内容。
